title: Intercompany receivables and payables by entity pair, invoice and currency
prompt: Reconcile intercompany receivables and payables by entity pair, invoice and currency, and explain differences before consolidation.

setup.q: Which entity pairs trade with each other (parent and subsidiary, subsidiary and subsidiary)?
Which ledger accounts are intercompany receivable and payable in each entity?
How are intercompany balances in different currencies translated and where do translation differences go?

inputs.name: Intercompany matrix and reconciliation for the period

steps: this is a size L parent: plan one child request per entity pair from the entityPairs setup; the parent delivers when every child is done
child: pull the intercompany matrix and both entities' IC account ledgers for the period
child: match by invoice reference, then by amount and date, in the transaction currency; translate under the stated FX policy only after matching
child: list differences by type: invoice on one side only, amount differs, currency or rate differs, timing (posted in different periods)
child: tie each side's IC balance to the matched invoices plus listed differences; propose an elimination entry only where both sides agree and the request asks for one
parent: assemble the pair results into one workbook; every pair appears even when it has no differences

done.text: Every entity in scope appears in the workbook
Every exception row cites the entity pair, the invoice reference and each side's transaction id
intercompany-reconciliation.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Any proposed elimination entry balances to the penny
Differences are listed per pair, invoice and currency with both sides quoted; translation differences are shown under the stated policy and never netted against invoice differences

tierRules.when: an elimination entry for a matched pair where both sides agree and the request asks for eliminations (optional)
